findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 26 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 16 questions numbered 1-16; by section: u-introduction-kevlar-poly-propene-keep-in-mind-systematic-nam 1, 26.1.1 3, 26.1.2 4, 26.2 2, 26.2.2 1, 26.3 1, 26.4.2 1, 26.5 1, 26.5.2 1, 26.6 1.

16 four-mark theory parts (the chapter teaches no numericals) covering polymers and their systematic names, addition polymerisation with poly(ethene), LDPE and HDPE with the Ziegler-Natta catalyst, PVC and plasticizers, condensation polymerisation, polyesters (PET), the three routes to polyamides, amide formation from acyl chlorides, nylon-6,6, nylon-6, properties and uses of nylon, identifying type/repeat unit/monomers, predicting the type from monomers, non-degradable polymers, biodegradable and photodegradable polymers, and polymers in artificial organs. The exercise's descriptive questions (compare addition and condensation, illustrate two condensation polymers, poly(alkene) vs polyester degradation) are not repeated. Book corrections followed: Ziegler-Natta; 2n H₂O / 2n HCl per n repeat units with two links; hexanedioic acid; PTFE = poly(tetrafluoroethene); non-degradable = cannot be broken down; photoabsorption.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
